patch_description: After the initial lattice and jittered multi-start pass, retain the strongest packing and use it as a continuation seed. Dense unequal-circle optima have many active contacts, so SLSQP can remain trapped in a nearby contact graph. Small deterministic perturbations of only circles away from the walls, combined with a slight temporary radius reduction, break selected contacts without destroying the successful boundary structure. Several short re-optimizations explore adjacent contact graphs and retain the best recovered configuration.
